external_gates.blocking_reason: No repository remote or target registry is configured; no tagged GitHub Actions run produced a registry digest.
prerequisites: Provide the private GitHub repository target and configure origin
Enable GHCR package write and GitHub OIDC permissions
Run a reviewed tag through container.yml and retain digest, Trivy, SPDX, provenance and Cosign artifacts
Apply an admission policy that verifies the immutable digest and attestations

external_gates.blocking_reason: kubectl has no current context; no staging cluster, TLS Secret, registry Secret, object store endpoint or smoke token was available.
prerequisites: Provide a named staging Kubernetes context and namespace access
Provision enterprise-doc-secrets, enterprise-doc-registry and the configured TLS Secret through a secret manager
Provide HTTPS staging and presigned object-store endpoints plus VITE_OBJECT_STORE_ORIGINS
Run deploy-staging.yml and retain migration, rollout, ingress, policy, event and authenticated smoke evidence

external_gates.blocking_reason: No isolated restore target, PostgreSQL backup/restore toolchain, compatible rollback target or measured RPO/RTO run was available.
prerequisites: Provide an isolated database restore target and real versioned backup
Select a compatible immutable release and rollback revision
Run restore plus data/application smoke, then guarded rollout rollback
Record backup freshness, restore and rollback timings, RPO and RTO with hashed command artifacts

external_gates.blocking_reason: Only bounded local checks exist; no production-like cluster, managed telemetry, GPU/vLLM environment or representative workload was available.
prerequisites: Provision an isolated production-like environment with immutable images
Run repeated ramp, steady-state, burst and recovery workloads with dependency telemetry
For model capacity, provision pinned GPU, vLLM, model and quantization settings
Record percentiles, errors, throughput, saturation, bottleneck and headroom through the evidence validator

limitations: Local Docker image IDs are not registry digests and were not pushed, scanned, signed or admitted.
GitHub Actions and GHCR were not run because no repository remote or target was provided.
Kustomize rendering is not cluster apply, TLS validation, secret-manager validation or authenticated staging smoke.
No destructive restore, production rollback or production capacity test was attempted.
